title: Amphophalus: modeled ₹627/qtl left, Kayamkulam → Kondotty
summary: January 2025: reported amphophalus prices at Kayamkulam and Kondotty imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 80% of 30 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹627 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 54 same-variety market pairs screened for amphophalus in January 2025; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kondotty report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2025
scenes.caption: Kayamkulam (Kerala) and Kondotty (Kerala) both reported amphophalus prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 30 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kayamkulam reported a median ₹3,900 per quintal. Kondotty reported a median ₹5,000 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,000/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,000 per quintal, and Kondotty was dearer on 87% of days.

scenes.headline: 272 km by road
scenes.caption: 272 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~4 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹58/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹471 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹205 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Kondotty report, the rule selects 23 of 30 modeled shipping days. 22 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹627 per quintal (₹363 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Amphophalus route from Kayamkulam to Kondotty was positive on 80% of matched days in January 2025. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹62,700, or ₹36,300 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to amphophalus
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹58/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Amphophalus route from Kayamkulam to Kondotty was positive on 80% of matched days in January 2025. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹62,700, or ₹36,300 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
